This is not because Steam is open: Controlled folder access in Windows Security is blocking this app (UWPHook works because it is already allowed). To fix this: Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Manage ransomware protection → Controlled folder access → Allow an app through Controlled folder access → Add Playhub.exe. Then try again.
